description:
Today on the Matt Walsh Show, it's not getting much attention from the media but one of the worst ecological disasters in American history is currently unfolding. A river of sewage is flowing into the Potomac. When you dig into this story, and who is responsible for it, you start to see why the media doesn't want to talk about it. Also, Canada euthanized a man with seasonal depression. This is yet one more atrocity committed by the Canadian regime, which I would argue is among the most evil on Earth. So when do we overthrow them, if we're in the business of overthrowing evil regimes? And CNN launches an attack on "Christian nationalism," but accidentally makes Christian nationalism sound great.
